text_en: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered:
text_cn: 纳阿玛人左法尔发言说：

text_en: “Should a multitude of words go unanswered, and should one full of talk be vindicated?
text_cn: 难道喋喋不休，就不需要答复？难道多嘴多舌的人，就证明有理？

text_en: Should your babble put others to silence, and when you mock, shall no one shame you?
text_cn: 你的空谈，岂能叫人缄（jiān）默？你如此谩骂，难道无人使你羞愧？

text_en: For you say, ‘My conduct is pure, and I am clean in God’s sight. ’
text_cn: 你说过：“我的品行是纯洁的，我在你眼中是清白的。”

text_en: But O that God would speak, and open his lips to you,
text_cn: 但愿天主讲话，开口答复你！

text_en: and that he would tell you the secrets of wisdom! For wisdom is many-sided. Know then that God exacts of you less than your guilt deserves.
text_cn: 将智慧的秘密，—— 即那难以理解的事 —— 启示给你，那么你便知道，天主还忽略了你的一些罪过。

text_en: “Can you find out the deep things of God? Can you find out the limit of the Almighty?
text_cn: 你岂能探究天主的奥秘，或洞悉全能者的完美？

text_en: It is higher than heaven —what can you do? Deeper than Sheol—what can you know?
text_cn: 完美高于诸天，你能作什么？深于阴府，你能知道什么？

text_en: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
text_cn: 其量长过大地，阔于海洋。

text_en: If he passes through, and imprisons, and assembles for judgment, who can hinder him?
text_cn: 天主若经过，谁能扣留他？他若下了逮捕令，谁能阻挡他？

text_en: For he knows those who are worthless; when he sees iniquity, will he not consider it?
text_cn: 他洞悉人的虚伪，明察人的罪行，且无不注意。

text_en: But a stupid person will get understanding, when a wild ass is born human.
text_cn: 如此，愚蠢者才可获得智慧，野性驴驹才能变为驯良。

text_en: “If you direct your heart rightly, you will stretch out your hands toward him.
text_cn: 你若居心正直，向他伸开你的双手；

text_en: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away, and do not let wickedness reside in your tents.
text_cn: 你若将手中的罪恶除掉，不容不义留在你帐幕内；

text_en: Surely then you will lift up your face without blemish; you will be secure, and will not fear.
text_cn: 那么你定能仰首无愧，一定站立稳定，一无所惧；

text_en: You will forget your misery; you will remember it as waters that have passed away.
text_cn: 你必能忘却痛苦，纵然想起，也必似水流去；

text_en: And your life will be brighter than the noonday; its darkness will be like the morning.
text_cn: 你的寿命如日中之光华，纵有阴暗，仍如晨曦。

text_en: And you will have confidence, because there is hope; you will be protected and take your rest in safety.
text_cn: 因有希望，你才感觉安全；因有保护，你才坦然躺卧；

text_en: You will lie down, and no one will make you afraid; many will entreat your favor.
text_cn: 你躺卧，无人敢来扰乱你，反而有多人来奉承你。

text_en: But the eyes of the wicked will fail; all way of escape will be lost to them, and their hope is to breathe their last. ”
text_cn: 然而恶人的眼必要昏花，他们安身之所必全毁坏，他们的希望只在吐出最后的一口气。
